meta.label: GoC Cav2p3 MA20
meta.note: The MA2020 GoC soma carries no Cav2.3 (parameters.py leaves the field at 0.0, so a zero conductance made this config compare nothing: current was identically 0). The value below is the fitted apical-dendrite density from Optimization_result.txt (values[3] = 1.28859564935e-03) and is used here only as a parity comparison scale, not as a somatic model parameter.
